label: Different Voices When a Husband Takes His Wife’s Last Name

tier_table.tv_ja: find it + 形容詞では、itが形式目的語で、後ろの不定詞が内容を表すと読む。
tier_table.sentence: I live at my wife’s parents’ home, and I still find it a little hard to have so little time alone.

tier_table.tv_ja: 埋め込み節を含む長い動名詞句が主語となる文では、主語のまとまりを確定してから主節の動詞を探す。
tier_table.sentence: But fitting in with what each family thought was normal was harder than changing my last name.
They will live near her parents’ home, far from us.

tier_table.tv_ja: it-cleftでは、itの後の焦点部分とthat節を対応させて、何が焦点化されているかを読む。
tier_table.sentence: But was it only the name change that I didn’t like?
His mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became ill.

tier_table.tv_ja: 名詞の直後の過去分詞句は名詞を修飾することがあり、主節の動詞と区別して読む。
tier_table.sentence: The man adopted into his wife’s family was thankful that both sets of parents accepted his choice.

tier_table.tv_ja: 関係節を含む長い主語では、主語の範囲を見定めてから主節の動詞を特定する。
tier_table.sentence: The parent who does not want to hold their son back wanted his partner’s parents to feel grateful to him.
